description: Symptoms, unmet needs and related findings reported in Italy, shown as a circular chart.

title.text: Symptoms and unmet needs reported by people with lupus in Italy
subtitle: Symptoms and unmet needs: Lupus Europe, Swiss Knife Survey 2024, Italy (200 to 367 respondents per question). Related findings: PaLESiamoci survey, Italy (151
respondents, funded by GSK). Self-selected online respondents, not a prevalence estimate. Hover over a petal or a bar to read what it means. Click one to keep
it highlighted; click again to let go. The pale petal behind a bar is the share who experience the symptom regularly. Plain-language descriptions are general
explanations written for this chart, not survey results or medical advice.

rows.label: Rash
rows.desc: Red or raised patches on the skin, often across the cheeks and nose (a “butterfly” rash) or on skin exposed to the sun.
